membership.create.what: Record that you started the circle.

membership.join.what: Record that someone becomes a member.

membership.leave.what: Record that you leave the circle.

membership.evict.what: Record that an admin removes a member.

membership.addressRevoke.what: Withdraw one of your devices' addresses.

membership.personKey.what: Tell the circle your new key.

membership.rulesAccept.what: Agree again to the circle's rules.

membership.props.what: Change what others see of you: your name, your picture.
